FT._DEBUG.summary: Developer access, not for production use

history: Added Text Indexing and Search support
Added WITHCURSOR, ADDSCORES and SCORER options, TOLIST, FIRST_VALUE and RANDOM_SAMPLE reducers, VECTOR_RANGE queries and HYBRID_POLICY, and LOAD ... AS (with `search.emulate-release 1.3.0`)
FT.AGGREGATE.summary: Performs a search of the specified index. The keys which match the query expression are subjected to further processing as specified

history: Added Text Indexing and Search support
Added FILTER, SCORE_FIELD, NOHL and SORTABLE UNF options, FLOAT16 and BFLOAT16 vector types, and LANGUAGE values beyond ENGLISH, with per-language punctuation, stop words, and stemming

arguments.name: SCORE_FIELD
arguments.description: Document field whose numeric value is used as the document's custom score

arguments.name: schema
arguments.description: Schema definition: one or more field definitions

arguments.name: vector-params
arguments.description: Vector algorithm parameters (DIM, TYPE, DISTANCE_METRIC, INITIAL_CAP, M, EF_CONSTRUCTION, EF_RUNTIME)

FT.CREATE.complexity: Construction time O(N log N), where N is the number of indexed items
FT.CREATE.summary: Creates an empty search index and initiates the backfill process

FT.CURSOR.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of rows returned
FT.CURSOR.summary: Reads rows from, or deletes, a cursor created by the WITHCURSOR option of FT.AGGREGATE, FT.HYBRID or FT.SEARCH

FT.DROPINDEX.summary: Drop the index created by FT.CREATE command. It is an error if the index doesn't exist

history: Hybrid search combining text/filter and vector arms
FT.HYBRID.summary: Performs hybrid search combining a text/filter arm with a vector arm, fuses results via RRF, LINEAR or a user-supplied FUNCTION, and feeds the fused list through the FT.AGGREGATE post-pipeline.
FT.HYBRID.complexity: O(N+M) where N is the complexity of the SEARCH arm and M is the complexity of the VSIM arm.

history: Added Text Indexing and Search support
Reports the index FILTER, filter_rejected_keys and per-attribute SORTABLE and UNF, and the index SCORE and SCORE_FIELD (with `search.emulate-release 1.3.0`)
FT.INFO.summary: Detailed information about the specified index is returned
